stock.description: Smart City Development Holdings Limited functions as an investment holding company, with its primary operations in the building contracting sector across Hong Kong, the People's Republic of China, and Macau. The company's diverse activities are organized into four key segments. Its Construction Business handles a broad spectrum of services, including general building construction, electrical and mechanical engineering, and various renovation, alteration, refurbishment, and fitting-out projects, as well as decoration engineering. The Securities Investment segment is dedicated to strategic investments in both long-term and short-term marketable securities. Through its Property Investment segment, the company focuses on acquiring, investing in, and leasing real estate. Finally, the Money Lending Business involves direct lending activities. Established in 1988, the company is headquartered in Kwun Tong, Hong Kong. It was previously known as Deson Construction International Holdings Limited, adopting its current name in September 2020.
